mapper.select: SELECT B.BID_ID, B.PRODUCT_ID, B.BIDDER_NO, B.BID_PRICE, B.CREATED_AT, U.USER_ID AS BIDDER_ID, TO_CHAR(B.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT_STR FROM BIDS B LEFT JOIN USERS U ON B.BIDDER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE B.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY B.BID_ID DESC

SELECT product_id, auction_start_price, auction_end_time, status, CASE WHEN auction_end_time < SYSDATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS is_closed FROM products WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bids (product_id, bidder_no, bid_price) VALUES (#{productId}, #{bidderNo}, #{bidPrice})
mapper.update: UPDATE auction_holds SET hold_status = 'OUTBID_RELEASED', released_at = SYSDATE WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND hold_status = 'HELD'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auction_holds (bid_id, product_id, user_no, hold_amount, hold_status) VALUES (#{bidId}, #{productId}, #{userNo}, #{holdAmount}, 'HELD')
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, writer_no, auction_start_price, auction_end_time, status, is_deleted FROM products WHERE status = 'ONGOING' AND auction_end_time <= SYSDATE AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT bid_id, product_id, bidder_no, bid_price FROM bids WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY bid_price DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE auction_holds SET hold_status = 'CAPTURED', released_at = sysdate WHERE bid_id = #{bidId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transaction_history (product_id, trade_type, seller_no, buyer_no, final_price) VALUES (#{productId}, #{tradeType}, #{sellerNo}, #{buyerNo}, #{finalPrice})
mapper.delete: delete from wishlists where user_no = #{userNo} and product_id = #{productId}
